item.title: improve(ci): shorten GitHub-hosted outage runs (#123294)
item.summary: improve(ci): shorten GitHub-hosted outage runs (#123294) * ci: run push compacts without tooling lanes and stripe giants three-way * fix(ci): keep CompactNodeTestPlanMode internal knip --production flags the exported type as unused; no external module imports it. * ci: shard hosted lint and node tests Split core oxlint across hosted runners and use backend-specific compact Node admission caps while preserving Blacksmith behavior. * test(ci): guard plugin prerelease planner isolation
